label: Definition attenuation by regional tissue

provenance.anchors_note: curve anchors are [E] fits to the [S] body-fat bands in BARA_LESSONS section 1/section 5 M10 (BB <10%, strongman 15-25%, gachidebu ~30%) mapped through the regional-tissue profile; first geometry builds should tighten them

semantics: effective_definition = raw x A(region tissue) x G(muscle). A is a per-region-class piecewise-linear curve fitted to the reference pattern: bodybuilder (<10% fat) full definition; strongman (15-25%) valleys soften but mass reads; gachidebu definition mostly submerged EXCEPT the largest forms (yoke curve stays highest). Abdomen submerges fastest; forearms/calves (limb_distal) keep definition longest. G is the muscle gate: definition over no muscle reads at the floor, not zero (lean untrained bodies do show separation).
